comment: Surface config for the REAL Claude desktop app. The app is Electron, so the driver attaches over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Launch paths are per-OS; selectors are best-guess and MUST be calibrated in one authoring run on a machine with the app installed and a dedicated test account logged in (see SETUP-DESKTOP.md). Calibration = run with --dump-dom and update the selectors below; no code changes.

linux.comment: No official Linux build; use attachOnly against a community repackage if your org allows it.
